text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen. First, you need to find the risks that could affect your project or business. These might include money problems, bad weather, or losing important staff. After identifying risks, you create mitigation strategies to reduce their impact. For example, you can buy insurance or train more employees. It is also wise to make contingency plans, which are backup plans for emergencies. Finally, you must keep monitoring the situation, because new risks can appear at any time. Good risk management helps you stay calm and prepared when difficulties arise.
